queries: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN derived_product_cost END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN derived_total_cost END), 0) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), avg_r AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.cost_ratio, inv.line_item_count, inv.cost_ratio / NULLIF(avg_r.avg_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM inv CROSS JOIN avg_r WHERE avg_r.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (inv.cost_ratio / NULLIF(avg_r.avg_ratio, 0)) IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: An invoice's ratio is SUM(derived_product_cost) / SUM(derived_total_cost) over its line items, using only lines where both values are non-null. A zero total gives a NULL ratio.
The average ratio across all invoices is the unweighted mean of the per-invoice ratios. Invoices with a NULL ratio are skipped.
The line item count is COUNT(*) of all the invoice's rows in Invoice_Line_Items, including rows with missing costs.
Rows with a NULL relative figure sort last. If the overall average is NULL or zero, no rows or NULL relative figures result.

alternatives.interpretation: Compute the ratio per line item, then average those line ratios within each invoice. The overall average is the mean of the per-invoice averages.

assumptions.assumption: An invoice's ratio is SUM(derived_product_cost) / SUM(derived_total_cost) over its lines, counting only lines where both values are non-null. The overall average is the plain average of the per-invoice ratios, so each invoice has equal weight.
The line item count is the number of Invoice_Line_Items rows for the invoice, including rows with missing costs.
A zero total cost (or zero average) gives a NULL ratio instead of a division error. Invoices with a NULL relative figure sort last.

alternatives.interpretation: The invoice ratio is the average of the per-line ratios (derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost), instead of a ratio of sums.
